name: inklusport-postman-newman
description: Ejemplo de la exposición: colección Postman de Inklusport ejecutada con Newman

scripts.test:html: newman run Inklusport.postman_collection.json -e Inklusport.local.postman_environment.json --delay-request 300 -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Inklusport — Newman"
scripts.test:salud: newman run Inklusport.postman_collection.json -e Inklusport.local.postman_environment.json --folder "00 — Salud gateway"
scripts.test:users: newman run Inklusport.postman_collection.json -e Inklusport.local.postman_environment.json --folder "01 — Auth" --folder "02 — Users"
scripts.test:access: newman run Inklusport.postman_collection.json -e Inklusport.local.postman_environment.json --folder "01 — Auth" --folder "04 — Accessibility"
scripts.test:reports: newman run Inklusport.postman_collection.json -e Inklusport.local.postman_environment.json --folder "01 — Auth" --folder "06 — Reports"
scripts.test:ia: newman run Inklusport.postman_collection.json -e Inklusport.local.postman_environment.json --timeout-request 180000 --folder "01 — Auth" --folder "07 — IA"
